class.name: OcgGpVec
class.brief_description: Defines a non-persistent vector in 3D space.
class.description: ! Defines a non-persistent vector in 3D space.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a zero vector.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a unitary vector from a direction theV.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a vector with a triplet of coordinates.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates a vector from two points. The length of the vector is the distance between theP1 and theP2

method.name: from_5
method.description: Creates a point with its three cartesian coordinates.

method.name: SetCoord_1
method.description: Changes the coordinate of range theIndex theIndex = 1 => X is modified theIndex = 2 => Y is modified theIndex = 3 => Z is modified Raised if theIndex != {1, 2, 3}.

method.name: SetCoord_2
method.description: For this vector, assigns - the values theXv, theYv and theZv to its three coordinates.

method.name: SetX
method.description: Assigns the given value to the X coordinate of this vector.

method.name: SetY
method.description: Assigns the given value to the X coordinate of this vector.

method.name: SetZ
method.description: Assigns the given value to the X coordinate of this vector.

method.name: SetXYZ
method.description: Assigns the three coordinates of theCoord to this vector.

method.name: Coord_1
method.description: Returns the coordinate of range theIndex : theIndex = 1 => X is returned theIndex = 2 => Y is returned theIndex = 3 => Z is returned Raised if theIndex != {1, 2, 3}.

method.name: Coord_2
method.description: For this vector returns its three coordinates theXv, theYv, and theZv inline

method.name: X
method.description: For this vector, returns its X coordinate.

method.name: Y
method.description: For this vector, returns its Y coordinate.

method.name: Z
method.description: For this vector, returns its Z coordinate.

method.name: XYZ
method.description: For this vector, returns - its three coordinates as a number triple

method.name: IsEqual
method.description: Returns True if the two vectors have the same magnitude value and the same direction. The precision values are theLinearTolerance for the magnitude and theAngularTolerance for the direction.

method.name: IsNormal
method.description: Returns True if abs(<me>.Angle(theOther) - PI/2.) <= theAngularTolerance Raises VectorWithNullMagnitude if <me>.Magnitude() <= Resolution or theOther.Magnitude() <= Resolution from gp

method.name: Angle
method.description: Computes the angular value between <me> and <theOther> Returns the angle value between 0 and PI in radian. Raises VectorWithNullMagnitude if <me>.Magnitude() <= Resolution from gp or theOther.Magnitude() <= Resolution because the angular value is indefinite if one of the vectors has a null magnitude.

method.name: AngleWithRef
method.description: Computes the angle, in radians, between this vector and vector theOther. The result is a value between -Pi and Pi. For this, theVRef defines the positive sense of rotation: the angular value is positive, if the cross product this ^ theOther has the same orientation as theVRef relative to the plane defined by the vectors this and theOther. Otherwise, the angular value is negative. Exceptions gp_VectorWithNullMagnitude if the magnitude of this vector, the vector theOther, or the vector theVRef is less than or equal to gp::Resolution(). Standard_DomainError if this vector, the vector theOther, and the vector theVRef are coplanar, unless this vector and the vector theOther are parallel.

method.name: Magnitude
method.description: Computes the magnitude of this vector.

method.name: SquareMagnitude
method.description: Computes the square magnitude of this vector.

method.name: Add
method.description: Adds two vectors

method.name: Added
method.description: Adds two vectors

method.name: Subtract
method.description: Subtracts two vectors

method.name: Subtracted
method.description: Subtracts two vectors

method.name: Multiply
method.description: Multiplies a vector by a scalar

method.name: Multiplied
method.description: Multiplies a vector by a scalar

method.name: Divide
method.description: Divides a vector by a scalar

method.name: Divided
method.description: Divides a vector by a scalar

method.name: Cross
method.description: computes the cross product between two vectors

method.name: Crossed
method.description: computes the cross product between two vectors

method.name: CrossMagnitude
method.description: Computes the magnitude of the cross product between <me> and theRight. Returns || <me> ^ theRight ||

method.name: CrossSquareMagnitude
method.description: Computes the square magnitude of the cross product between <me> and theRight. Returns || <me> ^ theRight ||**2

method.name: CrossCross
method.description: Computes the triple vector product. <me> ^= (theV1 ^ theV2)

method.name: CrossCrossed
method.description: Computes the triple vector product. <me> ^ (theV1 ^ theV2)

method.name: Dot
method.description: computes the scalar product

method.name: DotCross
method.description: Computes the triple scalar product <me> * (theV1 ^ theV2).

method.name: Normalize
method.description: normalizes a vector Raises an exception if the magnitude of the vector is lower or equal to Resolution from gp.

method.name: Normalized
method.description: normalizes a vector Raises an exception if the magnitude of the vector is lower or equal to Resolution from gp.

method.name: Reverse
method.description: Reverses the direction of a vector

method.name: Reversed
method.description: Reverses the direction of a vector

method.name: SetLinearForm_6
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theA1 * theV1 + theA2 * theV2 + theA3 * theV3 + theV4

method.name: SetLinearForm_5
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theA1 * theV1 + theA2 * theV2 + theA3 * theV3

method.name: SetLinearForm_4
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theA1 * theV1 + theA2 * theV2 + theV3

method.name: SetLinearForm_3
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theA1 * theV1 + theA2 * theV2

method.name: SetLinearForm_2
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theA1 * theV1 + theV2

method.name: SetLinearForm_1
method.description: <me> is set to the following linear form : theV1 + theV2

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a vector with respect to the vector theV which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a vector with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a vector with respect to a plane. The axis placement theA2 locates the plane of the symmetry : (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates a vector. theA1 is the axis of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales a vector. theS is the scaling value.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Transforms a vector with the transformation theT.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms a vector with the transformation theT.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
